subject: ORGANIZATION clause
notes: kb/Work PB706 (2026-09-22). The general format `[ORGANIZATION IS] { {LINE|RECORD} SEQUENTIAL | RELATIVE | INDEXED }` RENDERED from the printed page (PDF p357): ORGANIZATION, LINE, SEQUENTIAL, RELATIVE, INDEXED underlined; IS and RECORD NOT (optional words, --check 5.2.3). Grammar: `organizationType : LINE SEQUENTIAL | RECORD? SEQUENTIAL | RELATIVE | INDEXED` - RECORD SEQUENTIAL used to be a raw COBOL0001/0312 parse error at every edition. The written-out RECORD word is the 2023 inner choice (constructs.json file-organization-record-sequential-2023, COBOL0900 below 2023); bare SEQUENTIAL is ungated. The pb706 golden writes and reads back all three spellings (RECORD SEQUENTIAL, bare SEQUENTIAL with ORGANIZATION IS omitted, no clause).
